extras.textures: PBR 2048px: base color, roughness, metallic, normal (baked)
extras.real_size: straddle-beam monorail car on a short concrete guideway beam with one T-pillar, approx. 17.2 x 3.0 x 6.3 m (beam length x car width x height), car 13.6 m long; beam 0.86 x 1.5 m
extras.notes: one nose faces -Y (the car is symmetric, both ends have a cab); the concrete beam, pillar and footing are one object (monorail_beam), footing at z = 0; 8 guide wheels running on the beam flanks are separate objects with origin on their vertical axle (rotate around local Z in Blender / Y in glTF); load wheels are hidden inside the skirts; sliding doors modelled closed; opaque tinted windows, no interior; no brand, no text

origin.detail: Built procedurally with Blender scripts. The scripts were written with the help of an AI coding assistant. No generative AI model produced the geometry or textures directly.
